'''Tusken''' was the language spoken by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was considered very primitive; to the untrained ear, it sounded like shrieking and hollering. It also included many grunts, growls and honking noises used as punctuations. However, it was really a complex language, and people from other species found it very difficult to learn.<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Properly speaking in Tusken required a good amount of [[Wikipedia:phlegm|phlegm]]. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] could be properly equipped with a [[Tusken language pack]] for fluency.<ref name="GPBTG" />

Tusken language had no written form, relying instead only in oral tradition. The language consisted mostly of consonants.<ref name="u" />

==Known vocabulary or sentences==
*''Aargh.'' - Greetings.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Arg yowr rakak quaraka.'' - That time calculator belonged to my mother.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*[[B'Thazoshe Bridge/Legends|''B'Thazoshe'']] – Bantha horn turned to stone.<ref name="ITWAOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
*''C'rell'akt'' – Woman of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Out">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref>
*''Eyaak urk urk.'' – I mean you no harm.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Eyak ur urah gu.'' – Please leave my clothes.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*[[Gafsa/Legends|''Gafsa'']] – Waking place.<ref name="Out" />
*''Hu raka.'' – I surrender.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Iurak ip ip hurak?'' – Where is the nearest settlement?<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Koroght gaghgt Takt'' – Blessed be your going out from us.<ref name="Out" />
*''Kterskt'' – Danger.
*''Orukak!'' – Hands up!<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Orukak argg yurag?'' – Care for a drink?<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Oru uru kak.'' – Drop your weapon.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Prodorissac'' – Betrayer.
*''Ru rah ru rah.'' – I come in peace.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Skaterkst'' – Bad.
*''Tuyiskt sisktn'' – Hunting grounds.
*''Uli-ah'' – Child.<ref name="AOTCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*''Urrak!'' – Don't move!<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''Urrr urah urah urah?'' - Where is the nearest water?<ref name="GPBTG" />
*''[[Urtah/Legends|Urtah]]'' – Carrying pack.<ref name="AOTCVD" />
*[[Urtya/Legends|''Urtya'']] – Light tent.<ref name="AOTCVD" />
